stories.headline: Iran ‘examining’ new US peace proposal in presence of Pakistani mediator: Esmaeil Baqaei Pakistan has officially transferred Iran's newly revised 14-point peace proposal to the US in a bid to rescue a fragile West Asia ceasefire.
stories.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei announced that the country has received a new US peace proposal and is currently examining it. The proposal was received on Wednesday, during a visit from a Pakistani minister who is acting as a mediator. This development comes after Iran transferred its revised 14-point peace proposal to the US through Pakistan, in an effort to rescue the fragile West Asia ceasefire. Baqaei confirmed that Tehran's position has been shared with the US, but declined to reveal details of the revised proposal. The exchanges between Iran and the US are being handled through Pakistani mediation, with Iran having officially communicated its concerns to the US side. The examination of the new US proposal is underway, as part of the ongoing efforts to establish a lasting peace in the region.

stories.headline: Former Cuban president Raúl Castro indicted in US over 1996 fatal downing of two planes It's the latest move in the Trump administration's pressure campaign against Cuba's communist government.
stories.summary: Former Cuban president Raúl Castro has been indicted in the US over the 1996 fatal downing of two planes. The indictment is part of the Trump administration's pressure campaign against Cuba's communist government. The charges build on an earlier case filed in 2003 and mark an escalation of the US's multifaceted campaign against Havana. The downing of the two planes in 1996 resulted in fatalities, and the US has repeatedly denounced Cuba's communist system. The indictment of Raúl Castro is symbolic and intensifies pressure on the Cuban government. This move is the latest in a series of actions by the Trump administration aimed at increasing pressure on Cuba's communist government, further straining relations between the two countries. The indictment is a significant development in the long-standing tensions between the US and Cuba.

stories.headline: Israeli security minister stirs diplomatic outrage with flotilla activist abuse video Far-right figure Itamar Ben-Gvir shares footage of himself taunting bound international detainees
stories.summary: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has sparked a diplomatic crisis by posting a video of himself taunting bound international detainees from a Gaza flotilla intercepted by Israel. The footage, shared on social media, shows Ben-Gvir mocking the activists, prompting widespread international condemnation. Italy and France have summoned the Israeli ambassadors in their respective capitals in response to the incident. The video was posted on Wednesday, and the condemnation from various countries was immediate. The incident has led to a rare public rebuke, with several nations expressing outrage over Ben-Gvir's actions. The diplomatic fallout continues to escalate, with Israel facing criticism from multiple countries over the treatment of the detained activists and Ben-Gvir's behavior. The incident has strained relations between Israel and several European nations.

stories.headline: International Whitepaper launches abstract on role of strong opposition in Africa - Ghana Case Study for 2025/2026 Accra, May 20, GNA-An international whitepaper examining the importance of a strong and responsible opposition for democratic resilience, peace, and development
stories.summary: An international whitepaper has been launched, examining the role of a strong opposition in Africa, with Ghana as a case study for 2025/2026. The paper highlights the importance of a strong and responsible opposition for democratic resilience, peace, and development. It promotes responsible governance, protects marginalized groups, including women and persons with disabilities, and ensures accountability. The study is significant as Ghana's economy is expected to expand by 0.5% over the next 10 years through the AfCFTA. Effective governance and a strong opposition are crucial for assessing campaign promises and constitutional obligations. The whitepaper provides insights into the contribution of a strong opposition to Ghana's democratic development and its potential impact on the country's future. The launch of the whitepaper aims to foster discussion on the importance of a robust opposition in African democracies.

stories.headline: [PCMag] First Look: Samsung’s New 6K Odyssey G8 Gaming Monitor Is Pure Overkill-in the Best Way
stories.summary: Samsung has unveiled its new 6K Odyssey G8 gaming monitor, a 32-inch display that boasts impressive specs. The Odyssey G8 features a 6K resolution, offering a significant upgrade over 4K and QHD displays. This high-resolution monitor is designed for gaming and productivity, providing crisp and detailed visuals. With its advanced technology, the Odyssey G8 is poised to deliver an exceptional user experience. The monitor's release follows the success of Samsung's previous gaming monitors, including the Odyssey G9 OLED, which features a 240Hz refresh rate and OLED blacks. The new 6K Odyssey G8 is expected to be a top choice for gamers and professionals seeking a high-performance display. Early deals on Samsung monitors, including the Odyssey series, are already available, kicking off the Memorial Day weekend sales.

stories.headline: [9to5Google] Google says Magic Cue is coming to more apps on Pixel 10
stories.summary: Google has confirmed that Magic Cue, a feature on Pixel 10 devices, will be expanding to more apps. Magic Cue provides smart, contextual assistance across various apps, including Gmail, Calendar, and Messages, by connecting relevant information. The feature uses Gemini capabilities to proactively surface helpful information, reducing the need for app switching. Initially introduced on the Pixel 10 series, Magic Cue aims to make phone usage more efficient. Recent developments suggest that Google may be adding support for information from Tasks to Magic Cue, further enhancing its functionality. The expansion of Magic Cue to more apps was announced at the I/O 2026 conference, during the "What's new in Android" segment, indicating Google's ongoing efforts to improve the feature and user experience.

stories.headline: [Pure Xbox] Sony's Summer State Of Play Takes Place Within A Week Of The Xbox Games Showcase 2026
stories.summary: Sony has confirmed its Summer State of Play for June 2, 2026, an hour-long showcase featuring Marvel's Wolverine and updates on upcoming PS5 games. The event will be livestreamed on YouTube and Twitch, starting at 10 PM Kiev time. This announcement comes as Microsoft prepares for its Xbox Games Showcase 2026, scheduled for June 7, 2026, at 10 AM PT. The two showcases will take place within a week of each other, kicking off the Summer Games Fest week with at least one major presentation per day. The State of Play will focus on PS5 games, including Insomniac Games' Marvel's Wolverine, while the Xbox Games Showcase will highlight Microsoft's upcoming games for 2026 and beyond. Both events are expected to reveal new information and updates on highly anticipated titles.

stories.headline: [Teen Vogue] DIY Cyberdecks Are the Newest Analog Trend Taking Over Social Media
stories.summary: A DIY trend is emerging on social media, particularly on TikTok, where users are creating cyberdecks, portable, hands-on computing projects. The trend is attributed to TikTok user @ubeboobey, who showcased their cyberdeck, inspiring others to follow. Cyberdecks are personalized, cyberpunk-inspired machines that allow users to express technological creativity without the constraints of modern companies. Gen Z is embracing this trend as a way to reject the predictability of current technology and explore innovative, self-built computing solutions. These DIY gadgets are more than just a craft project, representing a desire for control and customization in the digital world. As the trend gains momentum, makers are sharing their cyberdeck builds, highlighting the intersection of technology, art, and self-expression. The cyberdeck community is growing, with users showcasing their unique, handmade machines on social media platforms.

stories.headline: José Mourinho’s Real Madrid return smashes Kylian Mbappé’s social media record
stories.summary: Fabrizio Romano's social media post confirming José Mourinho's return to Real Madrid has broken the record for most likes on his account. The post has garnered over 700,000 likes, surpassing the previous record held by Kylian Mbappé's Real Madrid signing announcement, which had around 634,000 likes. Mbappé's announcement, confirmed in 2024, had been the most liked post on Romano's account until Mourinho's news was revealed. The top three most liked posts on Romano's account now include Mourinho's return to Real Madrid, Mbappé's signing with Real Madrid, and Cristiano Ronaldo's transfer to Manchester United, with 700,000, 620,000, and 560,000 likes, respectively.

stories.headline: Joe Burrow raves about Bengals’ ‘most talented roster’ in his career
stories.summary: Joe Burrow expressed confidence in the Cincinnati Bengals' 2026 season, calling it the "most talented roster" he's seen since joining the team. The quarterback's endorsement comes after a busy offseason, which included defensive additions like Dexter Lawrence and Boye Mafe. Burrow has previously advocated for extensions or raises for key players, including Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Mike Gesicki, and Trey Hendrickson. He brought a positive attitude to the team's voluntary OTAs, highlighting the roster's potential. Burrow's statement suggests he believes the team has a strong chance of success in the upcoming season, even predicting a Super Bowl championship. The Bengals' offseason moves appear to have bolstered Burrow's optimism about the team's prospects.

stories.headline: Galliani on Italian football crisis and Calciopoli snipe at Inter Milan and Monza legend
stories.summary: Adriano Galliani, a Milan and Monza legend, has spoken out about the crisis in Italian football, highlighting the significant financial disparity between Serie A clubs and their European counterparts. He emphasized the need for reform to restore the league's former glory. Galliani also took a swipe at Inter Milan's Calciopoli title, referencing the scandal that led to Juventus being stripped of their 2006 title. He noted that it was the only time in history where the third-placed team finished as champions. Galliani's comments come amid concerns about the state of Italian football, including the national team's elimination from the World Cup. He suggested that the problems with the national team are reflective of deeper issues within Italian football, stating that the coach is more of a selector than a trainer. Galliani's remarks have sparked attention and debate about the future of Italian football.

stories.headline: How are the World Cup favourites shaping up?
stories.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup favourites are taking shape, with Argentina, led by Lionel Messi, aiming to retain their title. The top contenders include France, England, Portugal, Spain, Germany, Brazil, Japan, Morocco, and South Africa. Argentina won the previous World Cup and will look to defend their title from June 11 to July 19. France, the 2018 winners, and England, the UEFA Nations League finalists, are also strong contenders. Portugal, despite stumbling in qualifying, and Spain, with their talented squad, are also in the mix. Brazil, a five-time winner, and Germany, a four-time winner, will also be competing for the top prize. The tournament will feature a month of group play and knockout stages to determine the champion.

stories.headline: From strategic partnership upgrade to defence roadmap: Key outcomes of PM Modi-Meloni meeting in Rome
stories.summary: India and Italy have upgraded their bilateral relationship to a 'special strategic partnership' after a meeting between Prime Ministers Narendra Modi and Giorgia Meloni in Rome. The two countries agreed on a defence industrial roadmap for co-development and co-production of military platforms. They also reaffirmed their goal of expanding bilateral trade to Euro 20 billion by 2029. The discussions focused on strengthening cooperation across defence, trade, artificial intelligence, connectivity, and emerging technologies. The partnership aims to deepen cooperation in areas such as maritime security and technology. The meeting resulted in a comprehensive roadmap for cooperation, with a focus on trade, defence, and emerging technologies. The upgraded partnership is expected to enhance economic and strategic ties between the two nations. Key outcomes include a defence industrial roadmap and a target to expand annual trade to Euro 20 billion by 2029.

stories.headline: PM Modi conferred Food and Agricultural Organisation's highest honour, Agricola Medal, for contribution to global food security
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has been conferred the FAO Agricola Medal, the highest honour of the Food and Agriculture Organisation, for his contribution to global food security. The award was given in recognition of India's efforts in promoting food security and agricultural progress. PM Modi dedicated the medal to India's farmers, calling them the true strength behind the nation's food security. The FAO Director-General presented the award, stating it is an honour to award the Organisation's highest award to the Prime Minister. The FAO is the world's largest humanitarian organisation addressing hunger and promoting food security. The award reflects India's global recognition in promoting food security and agricultural development under PM Modi's leadership. The Prime Minister was congratulated by various leaders and dignitaries on receiving the prestigious award.

stories.headline: Kolkata man married to Pak woman arrested for spying for Pakistan intel
stories.summary: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested Zafar Riaz, a Kolkata resident, for allegedly spying for Pakistan Intelligence Officers. Riaz is married to a Pakistani national, and their children hold Pakistani citizenship. He was taken into custody after a Look-Out Circular was issued. The NIA claims that Riaz shared sensitive security information with Pakistan Intelligence Officers as part of a wider anti-India terror conspiracy. The agency believes this case points to a larger espionage network. The arrest comes amid increased surveillance on espionage activities in India following the Pahalgam terror attack. Riaz's arrest is one of several recent cases of individuals accused of spying for Pakistan, highlighting concerns over a potential network of spies operating in the country. The NIA is investigating the matter further to uncover the extent of the alleged espionage network.

stories.headline: PM calls crucial council meeting today, all ministers asked to stay in Delhi
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will chair a crucial meeting of the Council of Ministers at 4 pm on Thursday at Seva Teerth in Delhi. All Union ministers have been asked to remain in Delhi ahead of the meeting. The meeting is expected to discuss key issues, including governance and the West Asia crisis. PM Modi's decision to call the meeting has prompted all ministers to stay in the capital, indicating the importance of the discussions to be held. The meeting will bring together all Union ministers to address pressing matters and potentially make key decisions. Further details of the meeting's agenda have not been disclosed, but it is anticipated to be a significant gathering of the Council of Ministers. The meeting is scheduled to take place later today.

stories.headline: Putin, Xi hail 'unyielding' ties, gas pipeline deal remains unresolved
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese leader Xi Jinping met in Beijing, praising their "unyielding" partnership and growing energy trade. The meeting highlighted the strength of China-Russia ties, with Putin hailing an "unprecedented level" of relations. However, a key economic issue, the "Power of Siberia 2" gas pipeline deal, remained unresolved. The pipeline, which would run from Russia to China through Mongolia, is a major project sought by Russia. Despite the lack of progress on the deal, both leaders presented their partnership as a stabilizing force in a turbulent world. The meeting came just days after a visit by US President Donald Trump to China, underscoring the complex geopolitical dynamics at play. The unresolved pipeline deal leaves the project's fate in Xi's hands.

stories.headline: Chatbots Struggle With News Accuracy, Sourcing Ahead of Midterms
stories.summary: Researchers tested four major AI chatbots, including OpenAI's ChatGPT and Alphabet Inc.'s Google Gemini, on their ability to provide accurate and unbiased information about elections and geopolitics. The results showed that the collective answers failed on accuracy, bias, or source selection 90% of the time. Nearly 36% of answers to election-related questions contained at least one factual error. The chatbots struggled with news accuracy, particularly on breaking stories with limited online information. The AI models powering these chatbots are trained on large amounts of online data, which can be unreliable. The findings raise concerns about the chatbots' ability to provide trustworthy information ahead of the midterms, highlighting the need for improved training and sourcing methods to ensure accuracy and fairness in their responses. The tested chatbots also included Anthropic's Claude and xAI's Grok.

stories.headline: Grains, Livestock, and Geopolitics: How to Read What the Ag Markets Are Actually Telling Us
stories.summary: Grain and livestock futures experienced a downward trend, with market analysts attributing the shift to geopolitical headline risk. According to Tyler Schau, partner at AgMarket, geopolitical events impact both livestock and grains markets. However, Allison Thompson of The Money Farm suggests that grains markets are starting to focus on their own fundamentals, rather than being driven by war headlines. Key factors influencing the markets include production levels and stock rebuilding. A larger crop can shift market sentiment, while rebuilding stocks can change the conversation from fear to competitiveness. Analysts such as Darin Newsom and Allison Thompson are advising market participants to look beyond headlines and focus on market fundamentals to understand the trends in the ag markets. This approach can help readers interpret the actual signals from the ag markets.

stories.headline: Russia and China failed to finalise the Power of Siberia 2 pipeline deal, though leaders reaffirmed strategic ties, economic cooperation and energy dialogue amid
stories.summary: Russia and China failed to finalize the Power of Siberia 2 pipeline deal during talks between President Vladimir Putin and Chinese leaders. Despite this, both countries reaffirmed their strategic ties, economic cooperation, and energy dialogue. The proposed pipeline project is a multi-billion-dollar venture that Moscow has been pushing for. Although a deal was not reached, the two nations signed other agreements, deepening their commercial ties. The Power of Siberia 2 pipeline is a significant project that aims to strengthen energy cooperation between Russia and China. The failure to finalize the deal may be a setback, but the reaffirmation of strategic ties and economic cooperation suggests that both countries remain committed to their partnership. Further negotiations are likely to take place to move the project forward.

stories.headline: Congress and regional parties face growing pressure from BJP’s expanding dominance
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) continues to expand its dominance in India, putting pressure on Congress and regional parties. Recent Assembly polls in four states and one Union territory showed the BJP's growing strength, with the party sweeping the Manali civic polls by winning all 7 seats. The defeat of Mamata Banerjee's All India Trinamool Congress marks a significant shift in Indian politics, making survival tougher for regional parties. The BJP's winning momentum has been consistent, despite earlier predictions of decline. The party's national dominance has been recalibrated and rebuilt, posing a challenge to regional parties and Congress. The latest developments indicate a major shift in India's political landscape, with the BJP emerging as a formidable force. Regional parties are facing the heat, struggling to maintain their relevance in the face of the BJP's expanding influence.

stories.headline: The INDIA bloc’s biggest challenge is that it still lacks a settled answer to a basic question: is it merely an anti-BJP platform, or a genuine long-term political alternative
stories.summary: The INDIA bloc, formed as the main opposition to the BJP-led NDA, faces significant challenges. Since its formation in July 2023, the alliance has struggled with internal rifts and debates over its leadership structure. A key issue is the bloc's lack of a clear identity, with questions remaining over whether it is merely an anti-BJP platform or a genuine long-term political alternative. The alliance, which includes leaders such as Rahul Gandhi, Mamata Banerjee, and Akhilesh Yadav, has been unable to present a unified front, with some members openly questioning its leadership. This uncertainty has raised concerns about the bloc's ability to effectively challenge the BJP-led NDA. As a result, the INDIA bloc's future and effectiveness as a opposition force remain uncertain. The alliance's inability to resolve its internal issues has hindered its progress and impact.

stories.headline: As BJP Targets ‘Regionals’, Can Cong Get Act Together?
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is attempting to expand into regions where it has historically struggled to gain a foothold. The latest election results show the BJP taking the lead in West Bengal, with counting of votes underway. The main battle is between the BJP and the ruling Trinamool Congress (TMC), with the majority mark set at 148 seats. In another region, the BJP has made significant gains, with the NDA dominating the political map across the five districts of the Bodoland Territorial Region (BTR). The United People's Party Liberal (UPPL) has been wiped out, erasing its legislative footprint in the BTR. The BJP's efforts to make inroads in new regions will be closely watched, as it seeks to expand its national presence. The party has also made allegations against TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee and his family.

stories.headline: Effective Coalition Or Paper Tiger? The Split Reality Of The Anti-BJP INDIA Bloc
stories.summary: The INDIA bloc, an anti-BJP coalition, faces challenges in its long-term viability as a genuine political coalition. Despite its formation, the collective tally of the bloc in 2024 is similar to the Opposition numbers in 2014. The BJP's recent wins in assembly elections have gained it momentum, while grand alliances in Bihar, Maharashtra, and West Bengal are at risk. The Congress is considering switching allies in West Bengal, and seat-sharing and campaign strategy are key challenges for the opposition bloc. Recent developments in Tamil Nadu have exposed the Congress, weakened the INDIA bloc, and opened the door for a favourable political realignment for the BJP. Mamata Banerjee has urged opposition parties to form a joint platform against the BJP, highlighting the need for a unified strategy to counter the ruling party's growing momentum.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty rebound; RIL leads gains Indian benchmark equity indices, Sensex and Nifty, rebounded on Wednesday, recovering intraday losses, primarily driven by strong fag-end buying and a significa
stories.summary: Indian benchmark equity indices, Sensex and Nifty, rebounded on Wednesday, recovering from intraday losses. The 30-share BSE Sensex advanced 117.54 points to settle at 75,318.39, while the Nifty gained 41 points. The rebound was driven by strong fag-end buying and a robust rally in Reliance Industries, which rose 2.83%. Other gainers included Bajaj Finserv, Trent, and Axis Bank. Despite higher crude prices and a weaker rupee, the market recovered due to selective buying in large-cap stocks across autos, financials, and oil & gas. Brent crude traded 2% lower at $109 per barrel. The rally helped the Sensex and Nifty recover from early losses, with the Sensex closing 0.16% higher. The recovery was supported by buying in heavyweight stocks, led by Reliance Industries.

stories.headline: Stock Markets Today: Sensex, Nifty Surge as Global Markets Rally, Oil Price Eases Indian benchmark equity indices, Sensex and Nifty, opened higher, tracking positive global trends and easing crude oil prices, fueled by hopes of a swift resolu
stories.summary: Indian benchmark equity indices, Sensex and Nifty, surged due to positive global trends and easing crude oil prices. The rally was fueled by hopes of a swift resolution to global conflicts, particularly between Iran and the United States. Recently, Iran announced the Strait of Hormuz was open, leading to a decline in crude oil prices. Prior to this, Brent crude had spiked to a 7-year high of nearly $97/bbl due to concerns over supply disruptions. However, the current easing of oil prices has supported gains in Indian markets, with the Sensex and Nifty closing higher. The Sensex had previously closed at 82,055.11, up 158.32 points, and Nifty at 25,044.35, up 72.45 points, driven by renewed optimism and easing crude oil prices.

stories.headline: Stock market rebounds: Sensex recovers 790 points from day’s low, Nifty closes above 23,650 Indian stock markets staged a strong recovery, erasing morning losses. The Sensex and Nifty closed higher as oil prices dropped below $110 per barrel. Bond yiel
stories.summary: Indian stock markets rebounded strongly, with the Sensex recovering 790 points from its day's low to close at 75,399 and the Nifty closing above 23,650. The recovery was driven by a drop in oil prices to below $110 per barrel and a decrease in bond yields. The Sensex gained nearly 790 points, while the Nifty50 rose around 277 points. The rally was led by strong buying in banking, pharma, metal, and infrastructure stocks. Despite initial losses, the markets ended the session in the green, with the Nifty closing at 23,690. The rebound comes after a week of volatility, with the markets extending gains for a second consecutive session on Thursday, supported by robust buying in key sectors. The drop in oil prices and bond yields helped ease concerns over inflation and boosted investor sentiment.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty End Higher After Sharp Recovery From Early Selloff; Reliance Leads Rally Stock Market Today: The BSE Sensex ends 117.54 points higher at 75,318.39, recovering sharply after plunging nearly 600 points during early trade.
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex ended 117.54 points higher at 75,318.39, recovering sharply after plunging nearly 600 points during early trade. The Nifty rose 41 points or 0.17% to close at 23,659. The Sensex had dropped 625.08 points or 0.83% to 74,575.77 in early trade, but rebounded strongly, recovering over 1,100 points from its day's low. Reliance led the rally, driving the market's recovery. The benchmark indices had opened lower, with the Sensex and Nifty falling sharply in early trade, but staged a sharp comeback to end the day in positive territory. The recovery was significant, with the Sensex recouping nearly all its losses to end the day higher. The Nifty also closed near its day's high, at 23,659.

stories.headline: Oil prices fall after Trump says Iran negotiations in final stages Prices drop 6% but president warns of further attacks unless Iran agrees to a deal
stories.summary: Oil prices fell 6% on Wednesday after US President Donald Trump stated that negotiations with Iran were in the final stages. Brent crude futures dropped $6.64 to $104.64 a barrel, while US WTI futures decreased $6.49 to $97.66. Trump's announcement eased fears of further regional escalation, leading to the price decline. However, the president warned of potential further attacks unless Iran agrees to a deal. The significant drop in oil prices was the widest margin in over a month, with investors remaining cautious about the outcome of the negotiations. The development follows reports that the US believes it is nearing a deal to end the war with Iran, leading to a surge in stocks and a plunge in oil prices.

stories.headline: Indian Rupee Hits Record Low Amid Global Economic Pressures The Indian rupee has slumped to a record low against the US dollar, raising concerns regarding inflation and economic stability in India.
stories.summary: The Indian rupee has hit a record low against the US dollar, with recent reports indicating a drop to ₹96.88 and previously to ₹89.73. The sharp decline is attributed to various factors, including rising crude oil prices, firm US Treasury yields, and a stronger US dollar. This slump has raised concerns about inflation and economic stability in India, impacting markets and trade sectors. The rupee's fall is also linked to weak foreign inflows and global economic pressures. The record low has been breached multiple times, with the rupee previously touching ₹95.32 and ₹95.33 against the US dollar. The decline is being closely monitored, as it may have significant implications for India's economy and trade relationships. The Indian government and financial institutions are likely to take measures to stabilize the currency and mitigate the effects of the decline.

stories.headline: Carney says the world is facing an 'energy crisis' and Canada must help solve it In B.C. to meet with the province's premier who is sceptical of another oil pipeline, Prime Minister Mark Carney said the world is in the throes of an "energy c
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that the world is facing an "energy crisis" and Canada must contribute by providing necessary natural resources. He made this statement while meeting with British Columbia Premier David Eby, who is skeptical of another oil pipeline. Carney addressed a business crowd at the Greater Vancouver Board of Trade, indicating that Canada will focus on supplying liquefied natural gas and critical minerals for the clean energy transition. He suggested that building a new pipeline to ship oil to foreign markets could be an opportunity, but only if it's tied to significant green investments to reduce the industry's environmental footprint. This approach outlines the direction Carney plans to take Canada's climate and energy policies, emphasizing a balance between energy supply and environmental considerations.

stories.headline: Jeff Bezos says raising taxes on the rich won’t help average Americans Amazon Executive Chairman Jeff Bezos accused politicians of villainizing the ultra-wealthy and using tax policy as a political wedge issue.
stories.summary: Amazon Executive Chairman Jeff Bezos accused US politicians of villainizing the ultra-wealthy and using tax policy as a political wedge issue. He stated that raising taxes on the wealthy will not help average Americans. Bezos made these comments in response to ongoing discussions about tax policy and wealth distribution. According to him, politicians are using tax policy to distract from other issues. Bezos' remarks come as part of a broader debate about economic inequality and the role of taxation in addressing it. His comments have sparked attention, given his position as one of the world's wealthiest individuals and the executive chairman of Amazon, a major global corporation. Bezos' statement reflects his perspective on the relationship between taxation and economic outcomes for average Americans.

stories.headline: OpenAI prepares for record-breaking IPO OpenAI is preparing to confidentially file a draft registration statement for an initial public offering, according to reports confirmed by CNBC.
stories.summary: OpenAI is preparing to confidentially file a draft registration statement for an initial public offering (IPO). The company, known for its ChatGPT technology with 900 million weekly active users, recently raised $122 billion in its latest funding round, bringing its post-money valuation to $852 billion. The potential IPO could raise nearly $75 billion at a valuation approaching $1.75 trillion, making it potentially the largest IPO in history. If successful, this would surpass previous records and solidify OpenAI's position as a leader in the artificial intelligence industry. The company's plans are subject to review by the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) before the IPO can proceed. A successful listing would be a significant milestone for OpenAI and the tech industry as a whole.

stories.headline: OpenAI eyes confidential IPO filing as early as Friday Artificial intelligence company OpenAI is preparing to confidentially file a draft prospectus for an initial public offering (IPO) as early as Friday, CNBC repo
stories.summary: Artificial intelligence company OpenAI is preparing to confidentially file a draft prospectus for an initial public offering (IPO) as early as Friday. The company is in talks with major US banks, including Goldman and Morgan, to facilitate the filing. OpenAI is potentially targeting a $1 trillion valuation, marking a significant milestone for the artificial intelligence industry. The confidential filing could happen soon, pending resolution of legal challenges and evolution of financial strategies. The timing remains subject to change, but if filed, it would be a major step towards OpenAI's IPO. The company's decision to file confidentially allows it to test the waters without publicly disclosing its financial information. If successful, OpenAI's IPO would be one of the most highly anticipated and closely watched in recent history.

stories.headline: Intuit to cut 17% of global jobs to streamline operations, memo shows Intuit is cutting around 3,000 jobs globally. This move aims to simplify operations and boost focus on key areas, especially artificial intelligence.
stories.summary: Intuit is cutting approximately 17% of its global workforce, around 3,000 employees, to streamline operations and focus on key areas. The layoffs aim to simplify the company's structure and boost its focus on artificial intelligence efforts. The job cuts will affect employees across seven countries. An internal memo, seen by Reuters, revealed the company's plan to sharpen its focus on key bets, including AI. The move is intended to enhance Intuit's operational efficiency and concentrate resources on strategic priorities. The layoffs were announced on May 20, 2026, and will impact about 17% of the company's global workforce. The decision is part of Intuit's efforts to adapt and remain competitive in a rapidly changing business environment.

stories.headline: Chatbots Struggle With News Accuracy, Sourcing Ahead of Midterms Four major artificial intelligence chatbots — OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Alphabet Inc.’s Google Gemini, Anthropic’s Claude and xAI’s Grok — are struggling to fairly and
stories.summary: Four major artificial intelligence chatbots, including OpenAI's ChatGPT, Alphabet's Google Gemini, Anthropic's Claude, and xAI's Grok, are struggling to provide fair and accurate answers to questions about elections and geopolitics. A study by Forum AI found that these chatbots have difficulty sourcing and verifying information, leading to potential inaccuracies. The issue is particularly relevant ahead of the US midterms, where reliable information is crucial. The chatbots' limitations in handling complex and nuanced topics like elections and geopolitics raise concerns about their ability to provide trustworthy information to users. The study highlights the need for improvement in the chatbots' ability to source and verify information to ensure accuracy and fairness in their responses.
